consequence.statement: Cilium attaches tc BPF programs via tcx links by default on kernels 6.6+, which may conflict with third-party old-style tc BPF users.
consequence.remediation: Set bpf.enableTCX=false in Helm to continue with old-style tc BPF attachment.

assertion.statement: On Linux kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium now defaults to tcx BPF links for attaching tc BPF programs (bpf.enableTCX); setups with third-party old-style tc BPF users should set bpf.enableTCX=false to keep old-style attachment.
